name: Tests per City and Operator
description: How many Data, Voice and Speech tests each City has for each Operator.
query_sql:
SELECT City, Operator, cdr_type, COUNT(*) AS Tests
FROM (
  SELECT City, Operator, 'Data' AS cdr_type FROM selected_data
  UNION ALL SELECT City, Operator, 'Voice' FROM selected_voice
  UNION ALL SELECT City, Operator, 'Speech' FROM selected_speech
)
GROUP BY City, Operator, cdr_type
ORDER BY City, Operator, cdr_type
